title: pvConvertToCellGrid
body:
## pvConvertToCellGrid

Converts an unstructured grid, or a composite whose leaves are unstructured grids with linear cells, into a partitioned dataset collection of cell grids (vtkCellGrid). Field-data annotations written by the IOSS reader promote certain cell arrays to spatially varying discontinuous Galerkin (DG) attributes; data without annotations is converted too. Use it before pvComputeSides, pvCellGridElevation or pvCellGridProbe.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- VTK assumes all cells of one shape in a grid have the same order; mixed-order meshes may convert incorrectly.
- A cell grid is not a vtkDataSet, so dataset operations cannot take this output; keep the original branch for ordinary processing.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ConvertToCellGrid`. Identity: `filters/ConvertToCellGrid`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: The input. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid); data-object trees (multiblock or partitioned) (vtkDataObjectTree); unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":true,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid","vtkDataObjectTree","vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
